title: Email Marketing Manager
description:
Email Marketing Manager

As the Email Marketing Manager, you are a detail-oriented, hard-working problem solver with an optimistic attitude that can easily (and happily) wear many hats. You can uphold our company’s principles and values while adding to our unique culture.


As a member of our Marketing Team, you will broadly be responsible for multi-channel performance-based marketing. This is a strategic and executional role - we need someone who brings a wealth of domain expertise, gets the big picture, rolls up their sleeves and manages campaigns themselves. You’re an authority in leading and optimizing outbound campaigns and have experience delivering results at scale.


You are a strategic and results-driven marketer who’s particularly energized by outbound marketing and is deeply familiar with how technology and platforms enable multi-channel communications. You have experience personalizing and scaling customer-facing communications and workflows using marketing automation, deep qualitative and quantitative insights, and iterative experimentation to drive profound business impact and seamless, integrated customer experiences. If this sounds like you, join our growing team.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and manage all automated email campaigns and multi-channel workflows personalized or specifically targeted by customer segments where possible.
  • Develop and execute impactful communication campaigns informed by a test-and-learn approach, rigorous quantitative analysis, insights from market research, and overarching business goals.
  • Define the ideal consumer profile and plan to collect, grow, and segment data further over time.
  • Build the project roadmap and communication calendar for the email channel, launch and monitor direct response campaigns, and manage the developing tracking and reporting infrastructure.
  • Develop a systematic A/B split testing process to maximize user engagement and nurture customer acquisition.
  • Collaborate with other channel owners to ensure consistent messaging across all performance marketing mediums.
  • Be the main liaison with Salesforce Admin team members.
  • Own social media marketing management via HubSpot.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in email marketing strategy, execution, optimization, and reporting cycle.
  • 3+ years of experience in using CRM and marketing automation tools (HubSpot experience preferred).
  • Strong analytical skills with a passion for experimenting via split tests.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Excellent leadership skills with the confidence to lead, influence, engage and partner with cross-functional partners to drive business results.
  • Thrives in a fluid, fast-paced and results-oriented environment; able to adapt to changing business needs and influence decision-making across all levels of the organization.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing or associated studies.
  • C1 or C2 English proficiency level.

title: Full Stack Engineer, Brazil
description:

Optibus is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. Data Entry Assistant — Pilot R&D (Remote, Full-Time)


This role requires English proficiency , both written and spoken.


The Vision

At Pilot R&D , ingredients are the foundation of everything we do. As a culinary innovation and product development company, we help food and beverage brands bring their ideas to life — from cookies to kombucha. Behind every successful recipe is accurate, reliable data.


Accurate ingredient data powers all our work — and you’ll play a key role in keeping our internal database (The Walk-In) clean, organized, and reliable as we work across dozens of fast-moving projects.


Who We’re Looking For

We’re seeking a detail-driven, tech-savvy, and proactive person who enjoys structured work, organizing information, and solving small data puzzles.

If you love accuracy, can spot inconsistencies quickly, and enjoy turning messy inputs into clean, precise data — this role will fit you perfectly.

You’ll support our Ingredient Sourcing team by reviewing supplier emails, extracting critical details (pricing, MOQs, certifications, etc.), and entering them into our system with accuracy and consistency.


Why You Should Join Us

  • Be part of a fast-moving, innovative food and beverage development company working with top industry brands.
  • Join a small, collaborative team that values communication, curiosity, and growth.
  • Play a key role in shaping a new, foundational position within the company — you’ll help define what great data accuracy looks like for Pilot R&D.
  • Work remotely and independently , while still being connected daily through Slack and team check-ins.


Role Responsibilities

  • Enter all ingredient information into The Walk-In , our internal platform.
  • Upload supporting documents such as specification sheets, nutritional facts, GRAS and non-GMO statements, and certifications.
  • Input supplier data: pricing tiers, minimum order quantities, lead times, and FOB locations.
  • Set up new supplier profiles and maintain contact information.
  • Identify missing information and coordinate with the Sourcing Manager and Coordinator to complete data entries.
  • Perform regular data cleanup and validation to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Collaborate closely with the sourcing team to ensure smooth data flow and transparency.


Skills & Experience

Must Have:

  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong written and reading English skills.
  • Reliable communication and responsiveness during 9 AM–5 PM PST business hours.
  • Comfortable interpreting information from emails and attachments
  • Proficient in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office .
  • Proactive, organized, and comfortable following structured processes.
  • Tech-comfortable and willing to learn internal tools quickly.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Excel/Google Sheets or database tools.
  • Prior exposure to purchasing, procurement, or ingredient sourcing .
  • Background in food science, nutrition, chemistry, biology, or lab work.
  • Basic knowledge of coding or systems integration.
  • Familiarity with metric units .


Our Values

At Pilot R&D, our work blends innovation and science with a spirit of integrity and collaboration . We value clear communication, honest feedback, and building relationships — with our partners, clients, and team members. We believe in working hard, staying curious, and enjoying the process — after all, we’re making food for a living.


Compensation & Employment Type

Type: Independent contractor, Full-time (40 hours/week)


Location: Remote (LATAM preferred)

Hours: 9 AM – 5 PM PST

Compensation: Starting at $1,000 USD/month (depending on experience)

Timeline: Hiring within 30–90 days


Application Process

Please email the following to Maria+ :

Resume: As a PDF titled (Lastname.Firstname.DataEntry.pdf)

Cover Letter , including:

a) What interests you about working with Pilot R&D and this data-focused role

b) Specific experiences that show your attention to detail, organization, and reliability

c) How you stay focused and accurate when doing repetitive or technical work

d) What you enjoy doing outside of work


Well-structured, thoughtful applications will stand out. If you have any questions about the role or responsibilities, feel free to include them in your message.

title: Azure Devops Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to design, implement, and maintain cloud-native solutions across our Retail technology landscape.   • Perform SQL-based tasks and support BI/reporting workflows.
  • Participate in disaster recovery planning and testing.

  • Strong scripting/programming skills (Python, PowerShell, C#, Java, etc.).
  • Proficient with SQL Server and BI tools (SSIS/SSRS/SSAS).
  • Experience with infrastructure automation (Terraform, CloudFormation) and configuration management (Ansible, Chef).
  • Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills; familiarity with SRE and ITIL practices.

Desired Qualifications

  • Azure DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
  • Experience working with retail or wholesale trading systems

title: Senior HPC Cluster Support Engineer (Bright Cluster Manager + Slurm)
description:

  • Linux systems administration and advanced troubleshooting

  • Experience with InfiniBand , HPC storage systems (Panasas), and vendor escalation
  • Active Directory integration for Linux is a plus

title: AI Engineer
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a versatile and highly skilled AI Engineer to join our fast-growing Full-Stack AI Solutions company. This role blends the expertise of building cutting-edge AI/ML models with the practical know-how of automation and agentic system integrations. You will design, develop, deploy, and optimize intelligent solutions that leverage the power of generative AI, automation platforms, and agent-based systems to enhance client operations, streamline workflows, and deliver measurable results.

This is a unique opportunity to work across a diverse range of technologies—from fine-tuning transformer models to building real-world AI-powered automation stacks. If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI while creating real value through systems thinking and practical implementation, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities

AI/ML Development

  • Design, build, and deploy machine learning and generative AI models for custom use cases.
  • Fine-tune and optimize large language models (e.g., GPT, BERT) using frameworks like Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Conduct ongoing research to stay ahead of advancements in AI/ML, including LLMs, generative AI, and transformer-based architectures.
  • Develop data pipelines for preprocessing, feature engineering, and model training.
  • Test, validate, and monitor model performance in real-world scenarios; iterate for reliability and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed AI into products, platforms, and services.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical leadership.

Automation & Agentic Systems

  • Design, implement, and maintain automation workflows using tools such as:
  • LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse n8n, ElevenLabs, and CMS integrations.
  • Engineer system-to-system integrations using APIs to enable intelligent process automation.
  • Apply prompt and context engineering techniques to enhance the performance of conversational AI tools.
  • Implement prompt management and QA processes for agents and assistants.
  • Explore and deploy Microsoft Copilot Studio, PowerApps, and PowerAutomate solutions (preferred but not required).
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI and automation tools and assess their applicability in client use cases.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal teams to scope, deliver, and maintain agentic and automation solutions aligned with business goals.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development, including training and deploying models in production.
  • Strong programming skills in Python , with proficiency in frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn , and Hugging Face Transformers .
  • Experience working with AI tools like Langchain, OpenAI, or Stable Diffusion .
  • Practical experience with automation platforms and AI agent builders (as listed above).
  • Deep understanding of machine learning algorithms, neural networks, and NLP concepts.
  • Proficiency in using REST APIs for tool and platform integrations.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based AI/ML platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate business problems into technical AI/automation solutions.

Preferred

  • Experience working with Agentic AI frameworks , voice automation, and prompt tuning systems.
  • Exposure to MLOps best practices , including model versioning, CI/CD, and monitoring.
  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning , GANs , or edge AI deployments .
  • Familiarity with distributed computing frameworks such as Spark or Ray .
  • Background in AI agency workflows and client-facing solution delivery.


Work Environment & Benefits


  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
  • Flexible work environment: Remote-first .
  • Collaborative, innovation-driven culture with a commitment to personal and professional growth.
  • Opportunity to work at the forefront of AI innovation across industries and verticals.

title: iOS Developer (Objective C) (Req. English)
description:
Fetchly Labs is an innovative technology company dedicated to delivering cutting-edge mobile solutions in a remote, collaborative environment. Our projects focus on developing high-performance iOS applications that drive user engagement and business growth, utilizing advanced technologies and modern development practices.
Position Overview We are seeking a skilled iOS Developer to join our team. You'll build and maintain scalable mobile applications using modern iOS development technologies, with a strong emphasis on test-driven development and API integration.
Key Responsibilities
  • Develop native iOS applications using Objective-C and modern iOS frameworks
  • Design and implement robust mobile architectures following Apple's best practices
  • Practice test-driven development for reliable and maintainable code
  • Integrate with RESTful APIs and backend services
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and participate in code reviews
  • Optimize application performance and ensure smooth user experiences
Required Technical Skills iOS Development
  • Objective-C (required) and Swift (preferred)
  • Xcode and iOS SDK
  • UIKit and Auto Layout
  • Human Interface Guidelines and iOS design patterns
  • Responsive layouts and multi-device support (iPhone, iPad)
Architecture & Patterns
  • MVC, MVVM, or VIPER architecture
  • Dependency injection patterns
  • Delegation and protocol-oriented programming
  • Grand Central Dispatch (GCD) and concurrency
  • Memory management (ARC, retain cycles)
Backend Integration
  • RESTful API consumption (URLSession, Alamofire)
  • JSON parsing and data serialization (Codable, NSJSONSerialization)
  • Authentication and authorization implementation
  • GraphQL (nice to have)
Testing & DevOps
  • Test-driven development methodology
  • Testing frameworks: XCTest, XCUITest, OCMock, Quick/Nimble
  • Unit, integration, and UI testing
  • CI/CD pipeline setup (GitHub Actions, Fastlane, Xcode Cloud)
  • Version control with Git
Data & Storage
  • Core Data for local persistence
  • UserDefaults and Keychain for secure storage
  • Local caching strategies
  • CloudKit or Firebase integration
Nice to Have
  • React Native experience for cross-platform development
  • Swift knowledge
  • SwiftUI for modern declarative UI development
  • Firebase services (Analytics, Crashlytics, Cloud Messaging)
  • In-app purchases and subscription management (StoreKit)
  • App Store publishing and TestFlight distribution
  • Push notifications (APNs, User Notifications framework)
  • Universal Links and deep linking
  • Core Animation and advanced UI effects
  • Combine framework for reactive programming
  • Accessibility (VoiceOver, Dynamic Type)
Preferred Qualifications
  • 3+ years of professional iOS development experience
  • Published apps on the App Store
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills
  • Understanding of mobile app security best practices
  • Experience with Apple's App Review Guidelines
  • Knowledge of App Store Optimization (ASO)

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sr.
description:
Transformar o varejo da construção civil com tecnologia, inteligência e propósito — esse é o nosso negócio.

A Juntos Somos Mais nasceu em 2018 como uma startup de tecnologia com um sonho grande: impulsionar o setor de material de construção em todo o Brasil, conectando indústria, varejo e profissionais da obra por meio de um ecossistema de soluções inovadoras.


Com o apoio dos nossos acionistas — Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre —, movimentamos mais de R$10 bilhões em nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, impactando mais de 100 mil lojas e 1,2 milhão de membros entre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra.


Somos movidos por um time diverso, inquieto e protagonista — gente que sonha grande, age com autonomia e coloca o cliente no centro de tudo. Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.


Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais.


Seu papel:


Como Engenheiro(a) de Dados, suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Desenvolvimento de Pipelines Escaláveis: Criar e manter processos de ingestão de dados altamente eficientes (Batch, Streaming, CDC) para grandes volumes, garantindo a integridade, conformidade e resiliência dos dados.
  • Modelagem e Otimização: Projetar, implementar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Data Lake/Lakehouse, orientadas à governança e que atendam às necessidades estratégicas dos times de Analytics e Negócios.
  • Qualidade e Governança: Desenvolver e manter processos de tratamento, aplicando frameworks avançados de validação (como DQX) e garantindo a qualidade e acessibilidade dos dados.
  • Monitoramento e Suporte: Implementar ferramentas e práticas de monitoramento contínuo para garantir a disponibilidade, desempenho e conformidade do Data Lake, atuando de forma proativa na resolução de problemas.
  • Liderança Técnica em Governança: Liderar a implantação e utilização do Catálogo Unity no Databricks para documentar e organizar ativos, assegurando o cumprimento das políticas de governança de dados.


O que esperamos de você:

Buscamos um(a) profissional com as seguintes experiências e conhecimentos técnicos:

  • Arquitetura de Dados: Conhecimento profundo e experiência prática na aplicação de Data Lake, Data Warehouse e Lakehouse.
  • Linguagens e Frameworks: Proficiência em Python (scripts, automações, ETL/ELT, PySpark, Pandas) e SQL avançado (tuning de queries, modelagem, window functions).
  • Nuvem Azure: Experiência avançada com o ecossistema Azure, incluindo Data Factory, Databricks e Data Lake .
  • Engenharia Essencial: Sólida experiência em arquiteturas distribuídas e padrões de ingestão de dados (Batch, Streaming, CDC).
  • Governança de Dados e DataOps: Experiência em catalogação, linhagem, qualidade e aplicação dos princípios de DataOps e DMBoK .
  • DevOps/MLOps: Experiência na criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD com ferramentas como Github .
  • Segurança da Informação: Conhecimento e aplicação da camada de segurança (criptografia, LGPD e mascaramento de dados).


Habilidades Comportamentais:

  • Comunicação Eficaz, Empatia e Colaboração (Interação com Squads).
  • Senso de Urgência e Proatividade no contexto técnico.
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas complexos, através de visão analítica e raciocínio lógico.
  • Flexibilidade e Resiliência em cenários de alta complexidade.
  • Paixão pela Qualidade e Visão Holística do negócio.




Diferenciais:

Estes itens não são mandatórios, mas serão considerados um bônus para a posição Sênior:

  • Experiência em Liderança Técnica e/ou Arquitetura de Projetos .
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em SQL Server (SSMS, SSIS e SSAS) e ferramentas de visualização como Power BI .
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em análise funcional, modelagem de dados e elaboração de documentação técnica de soluções.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de três camadas, ambiente as a service, barramento (BUS) e orquestração.
  • Experiência com API’s para envio e recepção de informações e ferramentas como Excel no contexto de dados.


Nosso processo seletivo e compromisso com a diversidade

Na #Juntos, valorizamos a jornada de aprendizagem mútua: queremos descobrir, juntos, o potencial de cada pessoa em todas as etapas do processo. Nosso objetivo é criar uma experiência transparente, justa e eficiente, alinhada aos nossos valores e à nossa cultura de protagonismo e impacto.

Acreditamos que um time diverso e autêntico é essencial para gerar soluções verdadeiramente inovadoras. Aqui, você será encorajado a ser você mesmo(a), trazendo suas singularidades para somar ao coletivo. Promovemos inclusão de forma concreta, com ações afirmativas que buscam ampliar vozes de diferentes origens e perspectivas.


Se você busca um ambiente onde pode ser quem é, aprender com liberdade e contribuir com impacto real, seu lugar pode ser aqui. Vem construir com a gente o maior ecossistema da construção civil!

title: Desenvolvedor Java PL
description:
Cód. 55111


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


· Ei Dev, quer trabalhar em uma empresa com plano de carreira que coloca você como protagonista?


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Desenvolvimento de microserviços em Java e Spring Boot
  • Integração com RabbitMQ , AWS SQS e SNS (filas/mensageria)
  • Orquestração de containers com Kubernetes (K8s)
  • Criação de soluções em AWS (S3, Cognito)
  • Domínio de SQL
  • Consumo de APIs REST/SOAP
  • Linux básico


Conhecimentos desejáveis (diferenciais):

  • Noções de Node.js
  • Experiência em JavaScript
  • Testes unitários com JUnit
  • Integração e entrega contínua via Jenkins
  • Experiência adicional em Kubernetes
  • Experiência consolidada em AWS e arquitetura de microsserviços


- Quais atividades você deverá desempenhar?

Participar do desenvolvimento de soluções usando microserviços e práticas DevOps

Atuar na expansão e manutenção do pipeline de produtos

Contribuir em projetos de crescimento e flexibilidade do negócio

Monitorar e otimizar a performance dos sistemas

Colaborar com a equipe para alcançar os objetivos técnicos e de negócio


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Scheduling Optimization Engineer
description:
About You

You are a data-driven professional passionate about solving complex scheduling and resource allocation challenges. You thrive on applying advanced optimization techniques to real-world problems, balancing mathematical rigor with practical feasibility. You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Advanced knowledge of optimization modeling (integer programming, constraint programming, heuristics/metaheuristics).
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining large-scale scheduling models in applied environments.
  • Ability to incorporate operational rules, contractual agreements, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Hands-on experience with optimization solvers (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools).
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Julia, or C++.

  • Apply optimization solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools) to generate feasible, efficient schedules.
  • Collaborate with operations, planning, and technology teams to align outputs with real-world needs.
  • Analyze results to identify cost savings, efficiency improvements, and compliance risks.
  • Continuously refine models to adapt to changes in resource availability, demand patterns, and operational constraints.

You’re a highly creative, socially fluent designer who knows how to make people stop scrolling. You understand how content performs across platforms like TikTok and Instagram and know how to turn ideas into visuals that feel native, authentic, and viral.

You’re fluent in visual storytelling — from layouts and typography to repurposing video stills or designing carousels that tell a story. title: AI Engineer
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a versatile and highly skilled AI Engineer to join our fast-growing Full-Stack AI Solutions company. This role blends the expertise of building cutting-edge AI/ML models with the practical know-how of automation and agentic system integrations. You will design, develop, deploy, and optimize intelligent solutions that leverage the power of generative AI, automation platforms, and agent-based systems to enhance client operations, streamline workflows, and deliver measurable results.

This is a unique opportunity to work across a diverse range of technologies—from fine-tuning transformer models to building real-world AI-powered automation stacks. If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI while creating real value through systems thinking and practical implementation, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities

AI/ML Development

  • Design, build, and deploy machine learning and generative AI models for custom use cases.
  • Fine-tune and optimize large language models (e.g., GPT, BERT) using frameworks like Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Conduct ongoing research to stay ahead of advancements in AI/ML, including LLMs, generative AI, and transformer-based architectures.
  • Develop data pipelines for preprocessing, feature engineering, and model training.
  • Test, validate, and monitor model performance in real-world scenarios; iterate for reliability and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed AI into products, platforms, and services.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical leadership.

Automation & Agentic Systems

  • Design, implement, and maintain automation workflows using tools such as:
  • LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse n8n, ElevenLabs, and CMS integrations.
  • Engineer system-to-system integrations using APIs to enable intelligent process automation.
  • Apply prompt and context engineering techniques to enhance the performance of conversational AI tools.
  • Implement prompt management and QA processes for agents and assistants.
  • Explore and deploy Microsoft Copilot Studio, PowerApps, and PowerAutomate solutions (preferred but not required).
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI and automation tools and assess their applicability in client use cases.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal teams to scope, deliver, and maintain agentic and automation solutions aligned with business goals.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development, including training and deploying models in production.
  • Strong programming skills in Python , with proficiency in frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn , and Hugging Face Transformers .
  • Experience working with AI tools like Langchain, OpenAI, or Stable Diffusion .
  • Practical experience with automation platforms and AI agent builders (as listed above).
  • Deep understanding of machine learning algorithms, neural networks, and NLP concepts.
  • Proficiency in using REST APIs for tool and platform integrations.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based AI/ML platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate business problems into technical AI/automation solutions.

Preferred

  • Experience working with Agentic AI frameworks , voice automation, and prompt tuning systems.
  • Exposure to MLOps best practices , including model versioning, CI/CD, and monitoring.
  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning , GANs , or edge AI deployments .
  • Familiarity with distributed computing frameworks such as Spark or Ray .
  • Background in AI agency workflows and client-facing solution delivery.


Work Environment & Benefits


  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
  • Flexible work environment: Remote-first .
  • Collaborative, innovation-driven culture with a commitment to personal and professional growth.
  • Opportunity to work at the forefront of AI innovation across industries and verticals.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sr.
description:
Transformar o varejo da construção civil com tecnologia, inteligência e propósito — esse é o nosso negócio.

A Juntos Somos Mais nasceu em 2018 como uma startup de tecnologia com um sonho grande: impulsionar o setor de material de construção em todo o Brasil, conectando indústria, varejo e profissionais da obra por meio de um ecossistema de soluções inovadoras.


Com o apoio dos nossos acionistas — Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre —, movimentamos mais de R$10 bilhões em nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, impactando mais de 100 mil lojas e 1,2 milhão de membros entre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra.


Somos movidos por um time diverso, inquieto e protagonista — gente que sonha grande, age com autonomia e coloca o cliente no centro de tudo. Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.


Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais.


Seu papel:


Como Engenheiro(a) de Dados, suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Desenvolvimento de Pipelines Escaláveis: Criar e manter processos de ingestão de dados altamente eficientes (Batch, Streaming, CDC) para grandes volumes, garantindo a integridade, conformidade e resiliência dos dados.
  • Modelagem e Otimização: Projetar, implementar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Data Lake/Lakehouse, orientadas à governança e que atendam às necessidades estratégicas dos times de Analytics e Negócios.
  • Qualidade e Governança: Desenvolver e manter processos de tratamento, aplicando frameworks avançados de validação (como DQX) e garantindo a qualidade e acessibilidade dos dados.
  • Monitoramento e Suporte: Implementar ferramentas e práticas de monitoramento contínuo para garantir a disponibilidade, desempenho e conformidade do Data Lake, atuando de forma proativa na resolução de problemas.
  • Liderança Técnica em Governança: Liderar a implantação e utilização do Catálogo Unity no Databricks para documentar e organizar ativos, assegurando o cumprimento das políticas de governança de dados.


O que esperamos de você:

Buscamos um(a) profissional com as seguintes experiências e conhecimentos técnicos:

  • Arquitetura de Dados: Conhecimento profundo e experiência prática na aplicação de Data Lake, Data Warehouse e Lakehouse.
  • Linguagens e Frameworks: Proficiência em Python (scripts, automações, ETL/ELT, PySpark, Pandas) e SQL avançado (tuning de queries, modelagem, window functions).
  • Nuvem Azure: Experiência avançada com o ecossistema Azure, incluindo Data Factory, Databricks e Data Lake .
  • Engenharia Essencial: Sólida experiência em arquiteturas distribuídas e padrões de ingestão de dados (Batch, Streaming, CDC).
  • Governança de Dados e DataOps: Experiência em catalogação, linhagem, qualidade e aplicação dos princípios de DataOps e DMBoK .
  • DevOps/MLOps: Experiência na criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD com ferramentas como Github .
  • Segurança da Informação: Conhecimento e aplicação da camada de segurança (criptografia, LGPD e mascaramento de dados).


Habilidades Comportamentais:

  • Comunicação Eficaz, Empatia e Colaboração (Interação com Squads).
  • Senso de Urgência e Proatividade no contexto técnico.
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas complexos, através de visão analítica e raciocínio lógico.
  • Flexibilidade e Resiliência em cenários de alta complexidade.
  • Paixão pela Qualidade e Visão Holística do negócio.




Diferenciais:

Estes itens não são mandatórios, mas serão considerados um bônus para a posição Sênior:

  • Experiência em Liderança Técnica e/ou Arquitetura de Projetos .
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em SQL Server (SSMS, SSIS e SSAS) e ferramentas de visualização como Power BI .
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em análise funcional, modelagem de dados e elaboração de documentação técnica de soluções.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de três camadas, ambiente as a service, barramento (BUS) e orquestração.
  • Experiência com API’s para envio e recepção de informações e ferramentas como Excel no contexto de dados.


Nosso processo seletivo e compromisso com a diversidade

Na #Juntos, valorizamos a jornada de aprendizagem mútua: queremos descobrir, juntos, o potencial de cada pessoa em todas as etapas do processo. Nosso objetivo é criar uma experiência transparente, justa e eficiente, alinhada aos nossos valores e à nossa cultura de protagonismo e impacto.

Acreditamos que um time diverso e autêntico é essencial para gerar soluções verdadeiramente inovadoras. Aqui, você será encorajado a ser você mesmo(a), trazendo suas singularidades para somar ao coletivo. Promovemos inclusão de forma concreta, com ações afirmativas que buscam ampliar vozes de diferentes origens e perspectivas.


Se você busca um ambiente onde pode ser quem é, aprender com liberdade e contribuir com impacto real, seu lugar pode ser aqui. Vem construir com a gente o maior ecossistema da construção civil!

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento Pleno
description:
Missão da área

A área de Desenvolvimento transforma a visão estratégica da Serena em projetos reais, garantindo um pipeline robusto e sustentável. Atua como dona na alocação de capital, buscando excelência, questionando limites e convertendo oportunidades em ativos sólidos. Mantém o cliente no centro das decisões, antecipando riscos e resolvendo problemas relevantes do setor de energia com integridade e ética. A tecnologia é pilar essencial, usando dados, ferramentas digitais e IA para acelerar análises, qualificar decisões e impulsionar inovação. Incorporando soluções tecnológicas, simplifica processos e amplia a capacidade da Serena de gerar valor em um setor em constante evolução.


⚡Principais Responsabilidades

  • Originação e Estruturação de Projetos Mapear oportunidades de novos projetos, mercados e clusters. Realizar triagens iniciais, avaliando viabilidade técnica, regulatória e comercial;
  • Estruturar análises de viabilidade de forma crítica, organizada e consistente;
  • Gestão de Licenciamento e Regulação Acompanhar processos de licenciamento, autorizações e pareceres. Interagir com áreas regulatórias para garantir alinhamento técnico e prazos;
  • Antecipar riscos e sugerir caminhos preventivos;
  • Coordenação e Mobilização da Rede Engajar áreas internas (regulação, jurídico, engenharia, energia, mercado) para destravar temas;
  • Garantir clareza sobre o que cada área precisa entregar e quando;
  • Manter comunicação simples, direta e estruturada para evitar retrabalhos;
  • Preparação de Materiais de Decisão Elaborar apresentações, notas e análises executivas para comitês;
  • Sintetizar informações complexas de forma clara, lógica e orientada à tomada de decisão;
  • Destacar riscos, opções, premissas e recomendações;


Requisitos da Vaga

  • Formação completa em Engenharia;
  • 1–3 anos em desenvolvimento de projetos de energia renovável;
  • Conhecimento nos processos de acesso (ONS/ANEEL), normativos do setor elétrico, fundiário, licenciamento ambiental, contratos e análises de recurso;
  • Conhecimento em Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI;
  • Inglês: Fluente.

Diferenciais: programação, MS Project, conhecimento adicional em GIS/QGIS



Soft Skills Desejadas

  • Capacidade de lidar com múltiplas frentes simultâneas
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva
  • Atenção a detalhes
  • Organização
  • Perfil analítico
  • Proatividade e autonomia
  • Senso de dono e gestão de prazos
  • Resiliência para ambientes complexos

title: Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 5 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You

  • You’re a full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 3+ years of experience.
  • You’re a product-minded engineer with a pragmatic approach to building software.
  • You write expressive readable and maintainable code instead of just hacking together something that only works.
  • You’re curious about IoT, WiFi and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.
  • You want to learn how a business operates and get exposure beyond just writing code.


About the Role

  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Javascript and deploy it via Heroku.
  • Work with the CTO to break down large projects into small shippable slices and execute on those projects.
  • Build API integrations with 3rd party software providers
  • Create intelligent scripts and integrations to automate WiFi management tasks
  • Create and review pull requests in Github.


Why Work at StayFi?

  • You’ll be working directly with the CTO and CEO on mission critical projects.
  • You’ll get mentorship directly from the CTO and senior engineers who can help you go from being a junior or mid-level engineer to being a true master.
  • As you continue to do good work and help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to learn the ins and outs of running a sustainable and growing business.
  • You’ll be working on a small team, so you’ll get the chance to have a large impact within our company and in the vacation rental industry at large.

title: Engenheiro de Machine Learning SR

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Você irá atuar em um projeto global do nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do setor de óleo e gás , assumindo um papel técnico-estratégico dedicado ao Azure DevOps (ADO) e às plataformas de dados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Trabalhar com estruturas de dados de média a alta complexidade em ambiente corporativo.
  • Atuar de forma hands-on com SQL para manipulação e análise de dados.
  • Transformar dados utilizando Azure Data Factory (ADF), incluindo criação e otimização de pipelines.
  • Implementar lógica e análises utilizando DAX.
  • Modelar dados (normalização, desnormalização e star schema).
  • Desenvolver e otimizar modelos DBT, incluindo criação de testes de dados.
  • Atuar com soluções em Azure para armazenamento, integração e processamento de dados.
  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes Azure DevOps: acessos, permissões, configurações de projeto, repositórios e integrações.
  • Colaborar com stakeholders internos e externos para avaliar automações, integrações e fluxos customizados dentro do Azure DevOps.
  • Oferecer direcionamento técnico sobre uso avançado da plataforma Azure DevOps, incluindo escalabilidade e integrações com GitHub, ServiceNow e serviços Azure.
  • Criar e manter automações utilizando Power Platform (principalmente Power Automate).
  • Comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos técnicos e não técnicos em inglês.


O que você precisa ter

  • Forte experiência em administração de Azure DevOps (ADO) e pipelines.
  • Experiência sólida com Power Platform, principalmente Power Automate.
  • SQL avançado (mandatório).
  • Experiência com ADF, Data Pipelines e orquestração de dados.
  • Conhecimento em DBT e DAX.
  • Conhecimentos de Azure Infrastructure.
  • Experiência em liderança técnica.
  • Perfil com forte senso de ownership e visão de dono da solução.
  • Inglês avançado (mandatório)



Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

Experiência com Python ou PowerQuery/Power BI.

Certificações relevantes:

  • DP-203 – Azure Data Engineer Associate
  • PL-500 – Power Platform Developer Associate

Experiência em ambientes corporativos com estruturas de dados complexas.

Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e atenção a detalhes.

title: ADP Tester
description:
ADP Tester – Workday to ADP Payroll Transformation

Title: ADP Tester (5–7 Years)

Location: Brazil 100% Remote

Type: Contract

Client: Kyndryl

Overview

We are seeking an experienced ADP Tester to support a large-scale Workday-to-ADP payroll transformation program. The consultant will be responsible for validating end-to-end payroll processing across Workday and ADP (GlobalView / Workforce Now / Celergo), ensuring data accuracy, compliance with payroll rules, and a smooth transition to the new payroll landscape. This role requires strong hands-on experience testing ADP payroll solutions, deep understanding of gross-to-net calculations, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in HR, Payroll, and IT.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, design, and execute test cases for Workday-to-ADP payroll integrations, including end-to-end payroll cycles.
  • Validate payroll processing results, including earnings, deductions, taxes, and gross-to-net calculations across ADP platforms.
  • Review and validate data mapping and transformations between Workday and ADP (GlobalView, Workforce Now, or Celergo).
  • Test inbound and outbound interface files between Workday and ADP, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to defined formats.
  • Execute functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT) for payroll-related processes.
  • Log, track, and document defects using the client’s defect management tools, working with technical and functional teams to drive timely resolution.
  • Support parallel payroll testing cycles by comparing legacy and new payroll results, identifying and analyzing variances.
  • Collaborate closely with Workday configuration teams, ADP SMEs, payroll operations, and project managers to clarify requirements, test scenarios, and acceptance criteria.
  • Develop and maintain test documentation, including test plans, scripts, scenarios, and status reports.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes, standards, and templates for payroll transformation projects.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5–7 years of hands-on experience testing ADP payroll solutions.
  • Practical experience with one or more of the following: ADP GlobalView, ADP Celergo, and/or ADP Workforce Now.
  • Strong knowledge of payroll rules, calculations, and end-to-end gross-to-net processing (earnings, deductions, benefits, taxes).
  • Experience testing payroll integrations, including validation of inbound and outbound interface files.
  • Ability to design and execute test cases, analyze results, and document defects in a structured way.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Experience working in cross-functional, global environments with HR, Payroll, and IT stakeholders.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Nice to Have / Preferred Qualifications

  • Understanding of Workday payroll configuration and Workday payroll interface (WPI) or similar Workday outbound interfaces.
  • Experience with large-scale payroll transformation or migration projects.
  • Prior experience working with global payroll across multiple countries and legal entities.
  • Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and working within structured project frameworks.

Engagement Details

This is a contract position supporting Kyndryl on a Workday-to-ADP payroll transformation initiative. Candidates may be based in the US, Brazil, or India and must be comfortable collaborating with distributed, multicultural teams located in multiple time zones.

title: Senior Python Software Engineer (AI)
description:
About Pyyne

Pyyne is a modern technology consultancy engineering the next generation of digital products and services.


At Pyyne, we believe in using technology to unlock business potential, create sustainable growth, and drive forward digital excellence. Our solutions range from advanced Software Engineering, Cloud, and Data & AI solutions.


Job Summary

Pyyne is seeking a Senior Software Engineer, skilled in Python and with experience developing solutions with LLMs to work as a Consultant out of our Brazilian Office. This is a high-impact role for Pyyne as we scale up our AI Services and onboard new and exciting clients in this sector. 


A successful candidate in this role will be self-motivated and responsible for the full product lifecycle, from architecting scalable systems to rapid prototyping and experimentation. If you are passionate about building robust, high-quality systems and want to make a significant impact on an innovative product, this role is for you. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect & Build : Design, develop, and deploy scalable, production-grade applications on AWS or GCP that serve as the backbone for our AI-powered products.
  • Develop AI Solutions: Implement and optimize sophisticated AI systems, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI agents, to solve complex client problems.
  • Innovate & Experiment: Rapidly prototype and experiment with cutting-edge LLM-based solutions, including prompt engineering, agentic workflows, and tool integration.
  • Champion Code Quality: Take ownership of the development lifecycle and champion best practices for writing clean, well-tested, and maintainable code.
  • Collaborate & Lead: Work closely with product, data, and business stakeholders to shape the AI product roadmap and provide technical leadership.


Must Have Skills: 

  • Expert-Level Python: 3+ years of professional experience with deep, demonstrated expertise in Python and its ecosystem for building robust APIs and data-driven applications.
  • Production Cloud Experience: A proven track record of designing, building, and deploying scalable, production-grade applications on AWS or GCP. You are comfortable with core services like Lambda/Cloud Functions, S3/Cloud Storage, EC2/Compute Engine, etc.
  • Hands-On AI Experience: You have built and shipped at least one AI-powered feature or application, demonstrating your ability to translate AI concepts into real-world solutions.
  • Engineering Excellence: You are a self-starter who takes ownership, writes
  • high-quality, maintainable code, and has a keen eye for detail.


Nice to Have Skills: 

  • Applied AI Development: Hands-on experience developing solutions with LLMs (e.g. via OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere APIs) and/or agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Google ADK).
  • AI Infrastructure: Familiarity with services like AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI.
  • Vector Databases: Knowledge of vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS) and semantic search concepts.
  • Modern DevOps: Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).


Benefits:

  • Salary Range from 3,443 - 4,120 USD/mo  
  • Flexible remote working environment.
  • Career development opportunities in a fast-growing company.

  • Develop native Android applications using Java and modern Android frameworks

title: Desenvolvedor Java PL
description:
Cód. 55111


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


· Ei Dev, quer trabalhar em uma empresa com plano de carreira que coloca você como protagonista?


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Desenvolvimento de microserviços em Java e Spring Boot
  • Integração com RabbitMQ , AWS SQS e SNS (filas/mensageria)
  • Orquestração de containers com Kubernetes (K8s)
  • Criação de soluções em AWS (S3, Cognito)
  • Domínio de SQL
  • Consumo de APIs REST/SOAP
  • Linux básico


Conhecimentos desejáveis (diferenciais):

  • Noções de Node.js
  • Experiência em JavaScript
  • Testes unitários com JUnit
  • Integração e entrega contínua via Jenkins
  • Experiência adicional em Kubernetes
  • Experiência consolidada em AWS e arquitetura de microsserviços


- Quais atividades você deverá desempenhar?

Participar do desenvolvimento de soluções usando microserviços e práticas DevOps

Atuar na expansão e manutenção do pipeline de produtos

Contribuir em projetos de crescimento e flexibilidade do negócio

Monitorar e otimizar a performance dos sistemas

Colaborar com a equipe para alcançar os objetivos técnicos e de negócio


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

title: Full Stack Engineer, Brazil
description:
About Optibus:

Optibus is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 350+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.


About the position (role & team):

Optibus is looking for a talented Full Stack Engineer to join our Planning R&D team in the mission of making transportation smarter and more efficient. We're seeking a mid-level engineer with a strong software development background and experience building and maintaining modern web applications.

As a Full Stack Engineer on the Planning Team, you’ll contribute to the development of features and improvements for our mass transportation planning products, collaborating with other engineers, product managers, and designers to create high-quality, user-focused solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Actively participate in the entire development lifecycle, engaging in technical discussions

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of full-stack web development
  • Experience with React client-side development
  • Experience with Node.js server-side development
  • Understanding of web application architecture
  • Familiarity with relational or NoSQL DBs (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in computer science or a related field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills


It would be great if you have:

  • Experience with Python
  • Experience with AWS or an alternative cloud environment
  • Experience in the mobility ecosystem
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and CI/CD processes


Optibus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. title: Scheduling Optimization Engineer
description:
About You

You are a data-driven professional passionate about solving complex scheduling and resource allocation challenges. You thrive on applying advanced optimization techniques to real-world problems, balancing mathematical rigor with practical feasibility. With strong analytical and modeling skills, you design solutions that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and ensure compliance with operational and regulatory requirements.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Advanced knowledge of optimization modeling (integer programming, constraint programming, heuristics/metaheuristics).
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining large-scale scheduling models in applied environments.
  • Ability to incorporate operational rules, contractual agreements, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Hands-on experience with optimization solvers (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools).
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Julia, or C++.
  • Strong understanding of data analysis for planning based on event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destination planning.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain advanced optimization models to solve large-scale scheduling problems.
  • Build models that consider event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destinations using available data.
  • Integrate operational rules, contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Apply optimization solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools) to generate feasible, efficient schedules.
  • Collaborate with operations, planning, and technology teams to align outputs with real-world needs.
  • Analyze results to identify cost savings, efficiency improvements, and compliance risks.
  • Continuously refine models to adapt to changes in resource availability, demand patterns, and operational constraints.

title: iOS Developer (Objective C) (Req. English)
description:
Fetchly Labs is an innovative technology company dedicated to delivering cutting-edge mobile solutions in a remote, collaborative environment. Our projects focus on developing high-performance iOS applications that drive user engagement and business growth, utilizing advanced technologies and modern development practices.
Position Overview We are seeking a skilled iOS Developer to join our team. You'll build and maintain scalable mobile applications using modern iOS development technologies, with a strong emphasis on test-driven development and API integration.
Key Responsibilities
  • Develop native iOS applications using Objective-C and modern iOS frameworks
  • Design and implement robust mobile architectures following Apple's best practices
  • Practice test-driven development for reliable and maintainable code
  • Integrate with RESTful APIs and backend services
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and participate in code reviews
  • Optimize application performance and ensure smooth user experiences
Required Technical Skills iOS Development
  • Objective-C (required) and Swift (preferred)
  • Xcode and iOS SDK
  • UIKit and Auto Layout
  • Human Interface Guidelines and iOS design patterns
  • Responsive layouts and multi-device support (iPhone, iPad)
Architecture & Patterns
  • MVC, MVVM, or VIPER architecture
  • Dependency injection patterns
  • Delegation and protocol-oriented programming
  • Grand Central Dispatch (GCD) and concurrency
  • Memory management (ARC, retain cycles)
Backend Integration
  • RESTful API consumption (URLSession, Alamofire)
  • JSON parsing and data serialization (Codable, NSJSONSerialization)
  • Authentication and authorization implementation
  • GraphQL (nice to have)
Testing & DevOps
  • Test-driven development methodology
  • Testing frameworks: XCTest, XCUITest, OCMock, Quick/Nimble
  • Unit, integration, and UI testing
  • CI/CD pipeline setup (GitHub Actions, Fastlane, Xcode Cloud)
  • Version control with Git
Data & Storage
  • Core Data for local persistence
  • UserDefaults and Keychain for secure storage
  • Local caching strategies
  • CloudKit or Firebase integration
Nice to Have
  • React Native experience for cross-platform development
  • Swift knowledge
  • SwiftUI for modern declarative UI development
  • Firebase services (Analytics, Crashlytics, Cloud Messaging)
  • In-app purchases and subscription management (StoreKit)
  • App Store publishing and TestFlight distribution
  • Push notifications (APNs, User Notifications framework)
  • Universal Links and deep linking
  • Core Animation and advanced UI effects
  • Combine framework for reactive programming
  • Accessibility (VoiceOver, Dynamic Type)
Preferred Qualifications
  • 3+ years of professional iOS development experience
  • Published apps on the App Store
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills
  • Understanding of mobile app security best practices
  • Experience with Apple's App Review Guidelines
  • Knowledge of App Store Optimization (ASO)

title: Senior HPC Cluster Support Engineer (Bright Cluster Manager + Slurm)
description:
Role: HPC Cluster Support – CIBA 4 (Senior)

Position Type: Part-Time Contract (20hrs/week)

Contract Duration: 6 months

Work Hours: EST or PST

Location : 100% Remote


We're seeking a Senior HPC Cluster Support Engineer to maintain and support large-scale production HPC environments running Bright Cluster Manager and Slurm . This role focuses on cluster operations, hardware troubleshooting, user support, and vendor coordination to ensure uninterrupted high-performance computing workloads.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and support HPC clusters: job submission issues, queue management, and user troubleshooting
  • Monitor cluster health and resolve node failures, networking issues, and domain problems

  • Collaborate with users and provide regular status updates

  • Strong experience with Bright Cluster Manager and Slurm
  • Linux systems administration and advanced troubleshooting
  • Hardware diagnostics, BMC remote management tools
  • Experience with InfiniBand , HPC storage systems (Panasas), and vendor escalation
  • Active Directory integration for Linux is a plus

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor – Full-Time)

Candidates must apply with an online portfolio in order to be considered.


WHO YOU ARE

You’re a highly creative, socially fluent designer who knows how to make people stop scrolling. You understand how content performs across platforms like TikTok and Instagram and know how to turn ideas into visuals that feel native, authentic, and viral.

You’re fluent in visual storytelling — from layouts and typography to repurposing video stills or designing carousels that tell a story. You think about content as part of a bigger narrative, not just a single post. You love collaborating with others, working fast, and iterating based on feedback.


WHAT WE NEED

ODDITY is seeking a Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor) to join our Growth Marketing and Organic Social team as we launch a new brand under the ODDITY portfolio.

This role will help define how the brand looks and feels across social media — shaping everything from post design to campaign visuals and creator-led content. You’ll translate ideas into cohesive, scroll-stopping creative that drives engagement, conversation, and brand awareness. We’re looking for someone who’s deeply tuned into social trends, understands the balance of storytelling and aesthetics, and can bring a strategic eye to organic social design.

Note: Our team works EST hours, and candidates should be available during standard business hours.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design a variety of assets for organic and paid social , including carousels, post graphics, stories, and light video edits
  • Help establish the visual identity for a new ODDITY brand , ensuring consistency and cohesion across platforms
  • Partner with marketing and creative teams to interpret briefs and bring ideas to life in visually impactful ways
  • Repurpose and adapt content for different social formats and trends
  • Collaborate closely with copywriters, growth leads, and creators to build assets that feel fresh, social-first, and culturally relevant


YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in graphic design for marketing or social media
  • Proficient in Figma, Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator (After Effects or Premiere a plus, but not required)
  • Strong eye for layout, typography, and visual hierarchy
  • Proven ability to design for social performance — balancing brand polish with native, engaging formats
  • Basic familiarity with AI design tools and interest in emerging creative technologies
  • Strong attention to detail and time management
  • Excellent communication skills and openness to collaboration and feedback
  • Impressive work ethic and willingness to work in a fast-paced and high-growth environment
  • Full written and spoken English proficiency


BONUS POINTS

  • Deep understanding of TikTok and Instagram aesthetics and trends
  • Experience supporting brand launches or rebrands


WHO WE ARE

ODDITY is a consumer tech company that builds and scales digital-first brands to disrupt the offline-dominated beauty and wellness industries. Using data science, AI, and tech innovation, we serve over 40 million users through personalized product experiences.

ODDITY owns IL MAKIAGE and SpoiledChild, and is now building its next breakthrough brand — launching soon.


With headquarters in New York City, an R&D center in Tel Aviv, and a biotechnology lab in Boston, ODDITY operates at the intersection of tech, science, and creativity. Our culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and impact-driven — ideal for those who thrive on building from the ground up.

title: Product Owner Sênior
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.

Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Buscamos uma pessoa Product Owner apaixonada por dados, performance e qualidade, para atuar na evolução do ecossistema de relatórios em Data Fabric, garantindo integridade, governança e eficiência no consumo das informações.

Se você domina GraphQL, APIs, análise de payloads e backlog de produto, e gosta de ambientes ágeis, técnicos e colaborativos, esse desafio é a sua cara!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Definir, priorizar e manter o backlog de funcionalidades e histórias de usuário relacionadas ao consumo de dados e geração de relatórios.
  • Atuar como principal stakeholder na validação de entregas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Definir padrões de requisição, resposta e manipulação de payloads complexos para consumo de APIs.
  • Construir e otimizar queries GraphQL para extração e composição dos dados no Orquestrador de Relatórios.
  • Trabalhar com Engenharia na definição de schemas, governança e padronização das APIs.
  • Liderar análises de dados migrados de sistemas legados, garantindo integridade e equivalência.
  • Definir e coordenar Testes de Equivalência (Equivalence Testing) entre legado e Data Fabric.
  • Colaborar com Data Stewards e Engenharia de Dados para entender origem, tratamento e disponibilização dos dados.
  • Conduzir discovery e refinamento de requisitos complexos, garantindo soluções escaláveis e performáticas.


Habilidades e Requisitos

  • Proficiência em GraphQL API
  • Análise de payloads e arquivos .JSON
  • Data Quality Monitoring
  • Conhecimento em ambientes de cloud
  • Análise exploratória de datasets

title: Client Services Representative
description:
Mobility Care Associate

Job Type: Full-time, Freelancer Position

Location: Remote - Brazil - Work from home


**** Resumes must be submitted in English for consideration ****

On behalf of our client, we are seeking a detail-oriented and process-driven professional with excellent communication skills to join the Mindglobal team as a Mobility Care Associate .

Mindglobal , listed in Gartner's 2021 Market Guide, offers corporate TEM (Telecom Expense Management) solutions for Fortune 500 enterprises around the world. They are adding new members to their Brazilian team.


Position Overview

As a Mobility Care Associate for Mindglobal , you are responsible for providing customer and technical assistance and support related to mobile device systems, hardware, software, company and carrier processes, and client procedures. You will respond to queries by inbound phone call, email and as assigned, respond in a timely and professional manner, isolate issues and requests, and determine and implement a resolution as per client specific company procedures.


This position is responsible for general customer service and completion of our clients’ day-to-day tasks within measurable SLA metrics.


What you'll do:

  • Quickly and professionally answer inbound client calls according to each client’s preferred greeting and nomenclature
  • Respond to requests for assistance sent by email and received by our Helpdesk Ticketing solution professionally and using appropriate templates, verbiage and guidelines, and within each client’s desired response SLA
  • Understand, access, and efficiently use carrier portals and other tools
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues involving clients’ supported hardware, Minglobal tools and carrier systems
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues involving clients’ supported MDM and related systems, Mindglobal published client- and inside-facing tools, and carrier portals
  • Research process, policy and procedure questions using available informational resources
  • Using appropriate and professional grammar and communication skills, advise client employees on appropriate action(s), timelines, outcomes, etc.
  • Follow Mindglobal’s standard help desk procedures according to each client’s agreements, preferences and processes as noted in the KB, and as may be advised by MCM/CM and Helpdesk management
  • Ensure 100% of your client-related work is entered, tracked and documented in our Helpdesk Ticketing system correctly
  • Provide guidance to clients’ employees on proper use of Mindglobal specific websites and tools
  • Understand and explain client-specific processes and procedures as well as carrier specific data to clients’ employees
  • Refer and redirect non-Helpdesk requests to appropriate resource(s)
  • Identify and escalate situations requiring urgent attention and to the most appropriate resource
  • Stay current with industry trends, mobile technologies, internal systems and information, changes and updates
  • Proper and appropriate use of PC/Laptop and related equipment for Mindglobal’s purposes
  • Proper and appropriate use of Mindglobal’s electronic tools and resources for Mindglobal’s purposes


Who you are:

  • Proficient and professional/native level English speaker and writer
  • Able to multi-task and juggle a large volume of tasks
  • Consistently reliable: able to be on time and present when scheduled
  • Professional behavior in the workplace, remotely, and anywhere your Mindglobal affiliation is known
  • Excellent communication skills – verbal and written
  • Self-motivated to be effective with minimal supervision
  • Detail, process and results oriented
  • Ability to avoid distraction and consistently work throughout a scheduled shift
  • Previous experience in mobile/wireless industry a plus


What Mindglobal offers:

  • Career Growth – Mindglobal prioritizes internal promotions.
  • Remote Flexibility – Work from home in Brazil.
  • Company Culture – A collaborative and supportive team environment.


Job Type: Full-time, Contract position

This is a freelancer position. Benefits (such as healthcare, paid time off or 13th month pay) are not provided. You will be an independent direct contractor ("freelancer") with Mindglobal and paid hourly for time worked. You will be scheduled to work 40 hours per week and as a contractor can choose your time off and holidays. If desired, you can be paid in US Dollars.


Compensation & Hours:

Pay: $5.50 USD per hour (at 42 hours/week this equates to $1000 USD/month)


Hours: Set schedule Monday – Friday, 3pm - 12am OR Saturday - Wednesday, 6:30am - 3:30pm OR Monday - Friday 9am - 6pm (Austin, TX, Central Time)


Horário de trabalho:

  • Turno de 8 horas


Idioma:

  • English (Obrigatório)

title: QA Engineer (Salesforce)
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $3,000 - $4,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Quality Engineer to join their high-performing engineering organization as they continue to innovate and scale their global product suite. As a leader in tech scouting and innovation management software, our partner empowers the world's top companies and research institutions to accelerate discovery, collaboration, and operational excellence.


As an Al-First Quality Engineer, you will go beyond writing and executing test cases. You will harness the power of Al to predict defects, optimize test coverage, and accelerate delivery. You will play a pivotal role in shaping how intelligent quality practices are embedded into every stage of their software development lifecycle.


What You'll Do:

  • Use Al-driven tools to generate, maintain, and optimize test cases, test data, and test automation against application(s) running on the Salesforce Platform
  • Strategically prioritize and drive forward the QA practice with a high degree of autonomy

￮ Identify and propose strategies for technical and testing problems affecting the team, communicate standards clearly, and secure buy-in on solutions.

￮ Champion use of AI to automate repetitive and time-consuming QA tasks, freeing the team to focus on high-impact testing, exploratory scenarios, and strategic quality improvements

￮ Manage and mitigate technical and testing risk across projects, ensuring the right testing scope and sequencing to achieve team objectives and enable faster, safer releases.

￮ Leverage predictive analytics to identify defect-prone areas and prioritize risk-based testing.

  • Collaborate with developers, architects, and product managers to integrate Al-powered quality checks into CI/CD pipelines and unblock Al-powered workflows
  • Validate AI/ML based functionality for accuracy and reliability as part of the release process.


What We're Looking For:

  • 3+ years of proven experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or SDET roles.

￮ Experience across the breadth of application testing types: end-to-end testing, load and volume performance testing, API testing, etc.

  • Proven experience with testing against the Salesforce Platform

￮ Understanding of platform and change management concepts: sandboxes, templates, packages, and changesets. Experience with Salesforce Second-Generation Managed Packages is strongly desired.

￮ Knowledge of platform limits and constraints to inform data volume testing

￮ Experience administering Salesforce and/or strong Salesforce configuration skills

  • Strong programming skills, with familiarity across several languages (C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, SQL, etc.).
  • Understanding of Al/ML concepts and hands-on experience using Al-enabled development and testing tools
  • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright preferred) and their intersection with Al tools (such as Playwright MCP Server)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, and cloud-native environments.
  • Self-driven work style, with initiative to exploring, learning, and applying novel concepts and techniques
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with a mindset for experimentation and continuous improvement.
  • Experience in analyzing data sets for defect prediction, anomaly detection, or performing root cause analysis.


Work Schedule: You MUST be able to work during core U.S. Time Zone working hours.  


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a growing company at the forefront of Salesforce-driven enterprise solutions.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

to deliver outstanding service.
